svg.title: Subscription and event flow for one bridged service

g.text: Subscription and event flow for one bridged service
Store the SampleAllocateePtr in the in-flight
table keyed by the minted slot_handle and wrap
write SOME/IP header and payload, shrink()
take sample out of the in-flight table
the sample and move the SamplePtr into its
payload destroyed, SamplePtr releases the slot
